FAQ

Questions about weighbridge software

What is weighbridge software?

It captures weight automatically from the indicator, links it to the vehicle and party, prints slips and generates bills. Sarvlekh adds camera proof and audit logs to prevent fraud.

Does it work with any weighbridge indicator?

We support most serial and Ethernet indicators; share your model and we will confirm.

Can it integrate with RMC, mines or plants?

Yes. Weighment data flows into dispatch, inventory and billing in the same Sarvlekh system.

Can the weighbridge system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the weighbridge system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
